hooks.command:
#wh-fmt
f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [ -n "$f" ] && bundle exec standardrb --fix "$f"; exit 0

#wh-check-lint
i=$(cat); [ "$(printf '%s' "$i" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = true ] && exit 0
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 2
bundle exec standardrb >&2 || exit 2

#steep
i=$(cat); [ "$(printf '%s' "$i" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = true ] && exit 0
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 2
bundle exec steep check >&2 || exit 2
